# Non-BYZ deduplicated monthly fallback pulse for Slot 76 (oe_pmam_).
# When BYZ scheduler slot 76 has already run this calendar month, global_var:oe_pmam_ran_m == oe_ml_month_now
# and this trigger evaluates false in O(1), preventing double execution.
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_pmam_fallback_pulse } }

oe_pmam_fallback_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { global_var:oe_pmam_ran_m ?= oe_ml_month_now }
		OR = {
			tag = MAM
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:MAM } tag = EGY }
			AND = { is_ai = no oe_pmam_is_host = yes }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		oe_ml_mark_start = yes
		if = {
			limit = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes }
			oe_pmam_monthly = yes
		}
	}
}
